content.text: [{"phase":"Prep","instruction":"Marinate the chicken breast in olive oil, yogurt, and spices for at least 30 minutes."},{"phase":"Prep","instruction":"Cook the brown rice according to package instructions."},{"phase":"Prep","instruction":"Chop the cucumber and tomato into bite-sized pieces."},{"phase":"Cook","instruction":"Grill or pan-sear the marinated chicken breast over medium heat until fully cooked, about 6-7 minutes per side."},{"phase":"Cook","instruction":"Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly."},{"phase":"Serve","instruction":"Layer the brown rice, sliced chicken, cucumber, and tomato in a bowl."},{"phase":"Serve","instruction":"Drizzle with additional yogurt and olive oil before serving."}]
